verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own corporate cards page advertises 2% cashback on its cards, so the product does offer cashback on card spend. The only evidence is a single marketing headline, with no documentation of how cashback is credited. Nothing shows whether it is automatic or needs manual redemption. Missing for 10: documentation that cashback is credited automatically without redemption steps, eligibility and terms details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can earn automatic cashback on card spend without manual redemption steps

citations.quote: Best Corporate Cards: 2% Cashback, Spend Controls & No FX Fees
